rows.minion: one of many; a hit takes them out
rows.standard: a real fight for one character

rows.brute: Wade in and hit whatever is closest.
rows.skirmisher: Hit and fade before the counter.
rows.controller: Shape the ground before the clash.
rows.leader: Hold the line and give orders.

rows.expose: The target is open to the next blow.
rows.silence: The target cannot speak or cast.

fields.note: {defence == 'hard-to-hit' ? 'Hard to hit: the first harm of a fight is halved.' : defence == 'evasive' ? 'Evasive: gets clear after taking harm.' : 'Hard to kill: a bigger clock.'}
